activity.notes: This manifest adds Churchill's second, separate premiership from 1951 to 1955 to the existing ATLAS person. It intentionally does not merge the term with his already-live 1940-1945 premiership.

sources.title: Sir Winston Churchill — GOV.UK
sources.citation_text: GOV.UK records Churchill's two separate premierships as 1940-1945 and 1951-1955.
